senses.definition: A chart or book showing the days, weeks, and months of a particular year.

examples.text: Segno la data sul calendario della cucina.
examples.translation: I mark the date on the kitchen calendar.
examples.emotion: thoughtful and precise, keeping track of plans

senses.definition: A single page of a calendar showing one month or a specific period of days.

examples.text: Stacco il calendario del mese vecchio per appendere quello nuovo.
examples.translation: I tear off the old month's calendar page to hang up the new one.
examples.emotion: nostalgic and turning a new page, feeling the passage of time
